about: Explanation rules for `rigtool invdiff` (engine inventory vs the rig's raw ARP + MSI enumeration). `match` is a case-insensitive regex on the canonical key path or the MSI product code; `side` is engine | reference | mismatch | any; `field` (optional) limits a rule to mismatches of that field. First matching rule wins. Add a rule only with the reason it is a design difference, never to hide an engine bug.

rules.why: The engine enumerates every loaded HKU hive whose name starts with S- (purge-win reg::loaded_user_sids), so S-1-5-18 (canonical HKU\.DEFAULT) is read; riglib Get-LoadedUserSids keeps S-1-5-21-* hives only.
LocalService / NetworkService hives: read by the engine (every loaded S-* hive), skipped by riglib (S-1-5-21-* only).
Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) user hives (S-1-12-1-*): read by the engine, skipped by riglib (S-1-5-21-* only).
